catalogs.query: SELECT relkind,relrowsecurity,relforcerowsecurity,pg_get_userbyid(relowner), has_table_privilege('app_runtime',oid,'SELECT') AND has_table_privilege('app_runtime',oid,'INSERT') AND has_table_privilege('app_runtime',oid,'UPDATE') AND has_table_privilege('app_runtime',oid,'DELETE'), has_table_privilege('app_runtime',oid,'TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER'), has_table_privilege('app_support',oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE,REFERENCES,TRIGGER'), EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM aclexplode(COALESCE(relacl,acldefault('r',relowner))) a WHERE a.grantee NOT IN(relowner,(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='app_runtime')) OR (a.grantee=(SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='app_runtime') AND a.is_grantable)), EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attacl IS NOT NULL) FROM pg_class c WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND c.relname='professionals'

SELECT polname,polcmd,polpermissive, ARRAY(SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE oid=ANY(polroles) ORDER BY rolname), pg_get_expr(polqual,polrelid),pg_get_expr(polwithcheck,polrelid) FROM pg_policy WHERE polrelid='public.professionals'::regclass
SELECT udt_name,is_nullable,character_maximum_length,column_default FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='professionals' AND column_name='phone_e164'
SELECT convalidated,condeferrable,condeferred,pg_get_constraintdef(oid) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.professionals'::regclass AND conname='ck_professional_phone_e164'

SELECT p.prokind,p.prosecdef,p.proconfig, pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner), p.prorettype='pg_catalog.void'::regtype, has_function_privilege('app_runtime',p.oid,'EXECUTE'), has_function_privilege('app_support',p.oid,'EXECUTE'), EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM aclexplode(COALESCE( p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a WHERE a.grantee=0 AND a.privilege_type='EXECUTE' ) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid=to_regprocedure('public.onboarding_activate_quick_tenant(uuid)')

SELECT c.relname,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity, has_table_privilege('app_support',c.oid,'SELECT'), has_table_privilege('app_runtime',c.oid,'SELECT') FROM pg_class c WHERE c.oid IN ( to_regclass('public.admin_account_controls'), to_regclass('public.admin_account_audit'))
SELECT data_type,is_nullable,column_default FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='tenants' AND column_name='whatsapp_channel_id'

SELECT c.convalidated,c.condeferrable,c.condeferred,c.confdeltype, ARRAY(SELECT a.attname FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=c.conrelid AND a.attnum=ANY(c.conkey) ORDER BY array_position(c.conkey,a.attnum)), ARRAY(SELECT a.attname FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=c.confrelid AND a.attnum=ANY(c.confkey) ORDER BY array_position(c.confkey,a.attnum)) FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.conname='fk_tenant_whatsapp_channel' AND c.contype='f' AND c.conrelid='public.tenants'::regclass AND c.confrelid='public.qr_channels'::regclass

SELECT i.indisunique,i.indisvalid,i.indnkeyatts, pg_get_expr(i.indpred,i.indrelid),a.attname FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class idx ON idx.oid=i.indexrelid JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=i.indrelid AND a.attnum=i.indkey[0] WHERE idx.relname='ix_tenant_whatsapp_channel' AND i.indrelid='public.tenants'::regclass

SELECT conname,convalidated,pg_get_constraintdef(oid) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.qr_channels'::regclass AND contype='c' AND conname IN ('ck_qr_channel_senders','ck_qr_channel_private_policy')
